2 The detector: an LSTM autoencoder that learns to rebuild normal windows

Between 69k and 101k weights depending on the number of sensors. A flat 4-layer autoencoder (MLP-AE) on the same windows and Isolation Forest are the comparison detectors; 'Scratch' is this network with random weights and no training at all.

Instrument: the size of the change in θ at every round, ‖θ_new − θ_old‖
Corrected: about 0.1 per round on every dataset. Broken: exactly 0.000 on every round of all 25 control runs. The broken run's loss curve still goes down, because the copy keeps
learning each task's support windows, and its validation loss is an ordinary-looking number. Without this instrument the two runs are indistinguishable; the only difference
shows up in the score table, where the 'meta-model' from the broken run is the random network from band 2.
